question: What additional offenses requiring expiation are listed after the first group?
premises: The list of grave offenders continues.
It includes theft of divine property, striking sacred forms, and breaking a linga.
It also includes neglecting daily rites and falling from proper discipline.
inference: Expiation applies both to direct sacrilege and to serious neglect of obligatory religious discipline.
uncertainties: The phrase 'own measure and equipment' is compact and may refer to prescribed personal or ritual standards.
plain_english: Also included are one who takes the property of the gods or strikes a sacred form, one who breaks a linga, and one who neglects the daily rites and has fallen from his proper measure and equipment.
